blocks.text: Lower Landing home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

6 townhomes sold in Lower Landing with a median price of $613,950, taking a median of 97 days to sell at 99.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $389 per square foot, a median year built of 2025 and a median strata fee of $70 a month. 5 houses sold in Lower Landing with a median price of $1,015,000, taking a median of 48 days to sell at 98.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $427 per square foot, a median year built of 2025 and a median lot of 3,712 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
